tagline: Compiled exploration & exchanges focusing on **AIOps**, **AI platforms at scale** & **AI-first teams**
tagline-2026-11-10: Shape an AIOps future: share our vision of **No Touch operations** with human oversight, gather insights & build an ecosystem with other **industry experts & leaders**
tagline-2026-11-11: Re-engineer the way we work with AI: how **services are operated**, **platforms are built** and **engineers & ops collaborate** – on-site event where tech & non-tech audiences meet global experts & industry leaders
description: Welcome to Amadeus Wanderloop @ Erding 2026, a conference organized by the Amadeus Developer Relations team.

tracks.name: AIOps
tracks.description:
**How to operate services to cope with an increased number of changes.**

Low touch & no-touch ops, autonomous platform agents, predictive observability, self-healing architectures, intent-driven testing & validation

tracks.name: AI platforms at scale
tracks.description:
**How do we build & manage systems for an AI workload.**

Operational excellence, culture of stability, resilience, security, AI cost management & ROI, AI-DLC, infrastructure management, internal developer platforms & knowledge graphs

tracks.name: AI-first teams
tracks.description:
**How does AI affect our business and the way we work.**

Leading teams through AI transformation, skillsets evolution, AI-first engineering practices, intellectual property & value creation

sessionTypes.name: Talk
sessionTypes.description:
Attend a tech talk related to one of our 3 tracks.
We are open to a wide spectrum of topics, tech or adjacent to tech.
Five additional minutes provided for questions.

sessionTypes.name: Breakout session
sessionTypes.description:
Dive at the heart of an exciting topic.
This format allows for a comprehensive presentation & casual exchanges, which can cover large topics, while allowing many concrete examples.

sessionTypes.name: Snacks & Beers
sessionTypes.description:
The grand finale!
Amadeus offers the snacks & beers, while you bring the inspiring small-talk & the afterwork party vibes, to close the day on a high note.

sessionTypes.name: Partner booth
sessionTypes.description: Advertise your community, passion or brand on a dedicated booth during lunch time.
